test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The current population of a town is 50,000. If it is growing at 6%, compounded every year, what will be the population of the town after two years?
solution:
**Given:**

Current population of a town = 50,000

Increase in population every year = 6% compounded

Time = 2 years

**Concept Used:**

Amount = P(1+(r)/(100))^t

**Calculation:**

⇒ Population of a town after 2 years = 50000 × (1+(6)/(100))²

⇒ Population of a town after 2 years = 50000 × (106)/(100) × (106)/(100)

⇒ Population of a town after 2 years = 5 × 106 × 106 = 56,180

**Therefore, the population of the town after two years is 56,180.**
